answer_1.quote: Textual style transfer (ST) is defined as a generation task where a text sequence is paraphrased while controlling one aspect of its style.
answer_1.outputs: generated formal or informal rewrites of input sentences

answer_2.quote: Most works employ automatic evaluation for style (87%) and meaning preservation (83%).

answer_4.quote: Both studies recruited workers from the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform after employing quality control methods to exclude poor quality workers
answer_4.guideline: formality ratings are collected-for each system output-on a 7-point discrete scale... meaning preservation judgments adopt the Semantic Textual Similarity annotation scheme... fluency judgments are collected for each system output on a discrete scale of 1 to 5... overall judgments are collected following a relative ranking approach
